name: Shadow Demon
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The demon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Light Weakness
traits.description: While in bright light, the demon has Disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, the demon can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action, and it has Advantage on the ensuing Stealth check.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage. If the target is a creature, its Strength score is reduced by 1d4 until it finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0.

description: Shadow demons are cunning, incorporeal fiends that lurk in darkness on the fringes of battle, draining a victim's strength with a touch and vanishing into shadow before retaliation.
